mainEntity.name: How do I measure the success of AEO for my roofing business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO success involves tracking several key performance indicators. These include an increase in featured snippets and 'People Also Ask' appearances for your target questions, growth in organic traffic from direct answer queries, improved visibility in voice search results, and a rise in qualified leads or direct calls originating from these optimized channels. Monitoring changes in your local pack rankings and conversion rates from AEO-driven traffic also provides valuable insights into your strategy's effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure AEO success by tracking featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' appearances, organic traffic from direct answers, voice search visibility, and qualified lead generation.
